originalSource.title: Orbit Studio curated Explorer educational reference compilation

processing: Orbit Studio authors wrote the catalog selection, educational summaries, semantic search terms, simplified regions, representative orbit elements, and display geometry.

Official publisher pages were used to verify mission identities, nominal constellation architecture, orbit-family context, and the existence and geographic arrangement of NASA Deep Space Network complexes.

The representative plane samples, display colors, tolerances, synthetic orbital angles, approximate populations, and simplified geographic boundaries are Orbit Studio presentation data rather than copied operational ephemerides, boundary datasets, or live catalog records.

rights.licenseOrBasis: First-party Orbit Studio-authored compilation and expression; no third-party file, image, passage, catalog snapshot, or operational ephemeris is incorporated.
rights.attribution: Orbit Studio-authored educational compilation. NASA/JPL, GPS.gov, ESA, NOAA NESDIS, and the linked mission publishers are acknowledged as factual reference publishers; no endorsement is implied.

release.restrictions: Representative and simplified educational data are not operational catalog membership, measured current positions, precise geographic boundaries, or complete constellation inventories. Population and architecture summaries are approximate and time-sensitive.
